question: Who has been re-appointed, in August 2019, as the head coach of the Indian men’s cricket team till 2021 by Kapil Dev-led Cricket Advisory Committee (CAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Shastri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **former head coach of the Indian cricket team**, cricket commentator, and former captain, **Ravishankar Jayadritha Shastri **was born on May 27, 1962.
 
• **Mr. Ravi Shastri was chosen by the CAC** in a unanimous vote, and he has been reappointed as the** head coach of Team Indi**a from September 2019 till the conclusion of the **T20 World Cup to be held in India in 2021.**
 
• The** selection of the upcoming India coach** has finally been approved by the **Kapil Dev-led Cricket Advisory Committee **(CAC).
 
• August 16, 2019,** the Cricket Advisory Committee (CAC),** made up of **Ms. Shantha Rangaswamy, Mr. Kapil Dev,** and Mr. Anshuman Gaekwad, convened at the BCCI headquarters in Mumbai in accordance with the directives of the Hon'ble Supreme Court Appointed **Committee of Administrators (CoA).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1993 Indian Cricket named **Kumble the Cricketer of the Year**, and three years later he was named one of the Wisden Cricketers of the Year. Kumble, who was born in Bangalore, Karnataka, first became interested in cricket as a young boy by watching **players like ****B. S.** **Chandrasekhar** before becoming a full-fledged cricketer.
 
• Former international cricket player** John Geoffrey Wright MBE** (born 5 July 1954) captained and played for New Zealand. In 1978, he played his first match for his **country against England.**
 
• **Gary Kirsten, a South African cricket coach** and former player, was born on November 23, 1967. Both the South African and Indian cricket teams were **coached by him.**
